description:
This Diwali, we have shared the joy and warmth of the festive season with the people of Vikroli- Parksite through Ekata Mahila Samitee NGO (Having underprivileged ladies registered with them who serve as Ayyyas, house workers, house keeping workers, janitors and other class 4 workers) by distributing essential groceries needed to make Diwali snacks at home.

Project Details:

Grocery Kits 206 in number consisted of Pohe, Besan, Ghee, Oil, Sugar Suji and Maida costing Rs 545 each.
Project Lead- Rtn.Savita Govilkar.Savita Raised funds as below
- 25 K from RC Island City
- 20 K from RC Lakers Club
- 8 K from group of Donors headed by Soniya Chugh Ex RCBPian
- 9.5 K was borne by Ekata Mahila Samitee Founder Ms.Arati Chawla
- RC Bombay Powai donated 50K
